Lower Text: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
Upper Text: [Start of Your Main Phase] By trashing 1 [Mineral] or [Rock] trait card from your hand or your Digimon's digivolution cards, gain 1 memory.

[All Turns] When your Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them have the [Mineral] or [Rock] trait, by suspending this Tamer, you may place 1 [Mineral] or [Rock] trait card from your hand or trash as any of those Digimon's bottom digivolution card.
